native_contract: TransformerGenerator takes a gene token, actual control value and perturbation flag at the targeted gene position. Missing target positions cannot be represented by silently using all-zero flags.
required_extension: Supply the actual measured target-gene control value as an extra context token when outside output2000, preserve output-gene loss scope; restrict missing target/vocab eligibility before training and report coverage; compare pretrained and random initialization with identical inputs and budget.
